name: a

name: h

name: triangle
header: def triangle : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)

name: mem_triangle
header:
theorem mem_triangle {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} :
    x ∈ triangle ↔ a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < x 1 ∧ x 1 < h

name: measurableSet_triangle
header: theorem measurableSet_triangle : MeasurableSet triangle

name: level
header: def level (u t : ℝ) : ℝ

name: original_cutoff_square
header: theorem original_cutoff_square : h < 2 * a

name: level_bounds
residual_bounds
residual_pos
header: theorem residual_pos {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) : 0 < residual x

name: selected_full_squares
header:
theorem selected_full_squares {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) :
    2 * x 1 < level (x 0) (x 1) ∧
      x 1 + 2 * x 0 < level (x 0) (x 1)

name: cutoff_square
header:
theorem cutoff_square {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) :
    x 0 + x 1 + 2 * a < level (x 0) (x 1)

name: argument_mem
header:
theorem argument_mem {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) :
    argument x ∈ Icc (2 : ℝ) 5

name: alpha_ge_two
header: theorem alpha_ge_two {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) : 2 ≤ alpha x

name: residual_div_argument
header:
theorem residual_div_argument {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) :
    residual x / argument x = a

name: lowerAmplitude
header: def lowerAmplitude (s : ℝ) : ℝ

name: kernel
header: def kernel (corr : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) : ℝ

name: canonicalKernel
header: def canonicalKernel (corr : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) : ℝ

name: kernel_eq_canonical
header:
theorem kernel_eq_canonical {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle)
    (corr : ℝ → ℝ) : kernel corr x = canonicalKernel corr x

name: lowerAmplitude_eq_log
header:
theorem lowerAmplitude_eq_log {s : ℝ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hs4 : s ≤ 4) :
    lowerAmplitude s = Real.log (s - 1)

name: kernel_eq_log_of_argument_le_four
header:
theorem kernel_eq_log_of_argument_le_four {x : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ triangle) (hx4 : argument x ≤ 4) (corr : ℝ → ℝ) :
    kernel corr x =
      4 * (Real.log (argument x - 1) + corr (argument x)) / residual x

name: second_interval_witness
header:
theorem second_interval_witness :
    (![9 / 100, 1 / 10] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ triangle ∧
      argument (![9 / 100, 1 / 10] : Fin 2 → ℝ) = 675 / 139 ∧
      (4 : ℝ) < argument (![9 / 100, 1 / 10] : Fin 2 → ℝ)

name: integral
header: def integral (corr : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ

name: integral_eq_canonical
header:
theorem integral_eq_canonical (corr : ℝ → ℝ) :
    integral corr = ∫ x in triangle, canonicalKernel corr x * ∏ i, 1 / x i
